subject: Can I conduct "assocComp+removeComp" with missing value?

messages.author: 36488b271701c318
messages.subject: Can I conduct "assocComp+removeComp" with missing value?
parts:
Dear all, 

I have question about "assocComp+removeComp"  work again. 
Can I conduct "assocComp+removeComp" with missing value?

When i conducted assocComp with NA-included mBase (made by min.per.group during unite),
I got below error.

Error in svd(x, nu = 0, nv = k) : infinite or missing values in 'x'

And it happens again when i did work with example files and codes from "https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/3.7/bioc/vignettes/methylKit/inst/doc/methylKit.html#34_batch_effects"

below is script i tested for example set.

Regards, 
-Youngjune-


#########################################################
library(methylKit)
file.list=list( system.file("extdata",
                            "test1.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit"),
                system.file("extdata",
                            "test2.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit"),
                system.file("extdata",
                            "control1.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit"),
                system.file("extdata",
                            "control2.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit") )


# read the files to a methylRawList object: myobj
myobj=methRead(file.list,
           sample.id=list("test1","test2","ctrl1","ctrl2"),
           assembly="hg18",
           treatment=c(1,1,0,0),
           context="CpG"
           )

filtered.myobj=filterByCoverage(myobj,lo.count=10,lo.perc=NULL,
                                      hi.count=NULL,hi.perc=99.9)

meth=unite(myobj, destrand=FALSE, min.per.group = L)


sampleAnnotation=data.frame(batch_id=c("a","a","b","b"),
                            age=c(19,34,23,40))

as=assocComp(mBase=meth,sampleAnnotation)

Error in svd(x, nu = 0, nv = k) : infinite or missing values in 'x'



###############################################

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Can I conduct "assocComp+removeComp" with missing value?
parts:
no, you can not. You have to either remove missing values or impute them. The easiest is to remove them. imputing them and creating a new methylBase object is not trivial. 

Best,
Altuna
